description: Equivalence tests that verify INI and TOML configuration files produce identical parsed configuration structures. These tests ensure backward compatibility and validate that TOML native data types are correctly interpreted to match INI string-based values.

tests.name: Basic profile with string properties - INI vs TOML equivalence
Boolean properties - INI string vs TOML native boolean equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile default]
region = us-east-1
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
use_fips_endpoint = false
aws_endpoint_discovery_enabled = true

tomlInput.tomlFile:
[profile.default]
region = "us-east-1"
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
use_fips_endpoint = false
aws_endpoint_discovery_enabled = true

tests.name: Numeric properties - INI string vs TOML native integer equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile assume-role]
role_arn = arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ExampleRole
source_profile = default
duration_seconds = 3600
metadata_service_timeout = 30

tests.name: Array property - INI comma-separated vs TOML native array equivalence
Array property with whitespace - INI vs TOML equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile whitespace-test]
region = us-east-1
sigv4a_signing_region_set = us-east-1, us-west-2 , eu-west-1

tests.name: Empty array - INI empty string vs TOML empty array equivalence
All boolean properties - INI vs TOML equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile all-booleans]
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
use_fips_endpoint = false
aws_endpoint_discovery_enabled = true
s3_disable_express_session_auth = false
ec2_metadata_v1_disabled = true
disable_request_compression = false

tomlInput.tomlFile:
[profile.all-booleans]
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
use_fips_endpoint = false
aws_endpoint_discovery_enabled = true
s3_disable_express_session_auth = false
ec2_metadata_v1_disabled = true
disable_request_compression = false

tests.name: All numeric properties - INI vs TOML equivalence
SSO session configuration - INI vs TOML equivalence
Services configuration - INI vs TOML equivalence
Complete configuration with all sections - INI vs TOML equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile default]
region = us-east-1
use_dualstack_endpoint = true

[profile dev]
region = us-west-2
sso_session = my-sso
sso_account_id = 123456789012
sso_role_name = DeveloperRole
duration_seconds = 7200

[sso-session my-sso]
sso_start_url = https://my-sso-portal.awsapps.com/start
sso_region = us-east-1

[services s3]
endpoint_url = https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com

tomlInput.tomlFile:
[profile.default]
region = "us-east-1"
use_dualstack_endpoint = true

[profile.dev]
region = "us-west-2"
sso_session = "my-sso"
sso_account_id = "123456789012"
sso_role_name = "DeveloperRole"
duration_seconds = 7200

[sso-session.my-sso]
sso_start_url = "https://my-sso-portal.awsapps.com/start"
sso_region = "us-east-1"

[services.s3]
endpoint_url = "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"

tests.name: Credentials in profile - INI vs TOML equivalence
Mixed data types in single profile - INI vs TOML equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile mixed]
region = us-east-1
aws_access_key_id = AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
duration_seconds = 3600
sigv4a_signing_region_set = us-east-1,us-west-2
output = json

tomlInput.tomlFile:
[profile.mixed]
region = "us-east-1"
aws_access_key_id = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
use_dualstack_endpoint = true
duration_seconds = 3600
sigv4a_signing_region_set = ["us-east-1", "us-west-2"]
output = "json"

tests.name: Multiple profiles with different data types - INI vs TOML equivalence

iniInput.configFile:
[profile default]
region = us-east-1
use_dualstack_endpoint = true

[profile assume-role]
role_arn = arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ExampleRole
source_profile = default
duration_seconds = 3600

[profile multi-region]
region = us-west-2
sigv4a_signing_region_set = us-east-1,us-west-2,eu-west-1

tomlInput.tomlFile:
[profile.default]
region = "us-east-1"
use_dualstack_endpoint = true

[profile.assume-role]
role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ExampleRole"
source_profile = "default"
duration_seconds = 3600

[profile.multi-region]
region = "us-west-2"
sigv4a_signing_region_set = ["us-east-1", "us-west-2", "eu-west-1"]
